MK_SHADOWDARK.bastionWages.rule: 3 gp per warband level per week, multiplied by quantity.
MK_SHADOWDARK.bastionWages.incomplete: Some linked warbands or their levels are unavailable; their wages are excluded from this subtotal.
MK_SHADOWDARK.bastionWages.unavailable: Wages unavailable: linked warband or level missing.
MK_SHADOWDARK.bastionVault.ownerOnly: Only a GM or owner of this Bastion can manage Vault items.
MK_SHADOWDARK.bastionVault.transferOwner: You must own both the Bastion and the receiving actor to move Vault items.
MK_SHADOWDARK.bastionVault.sourceOwnersh: You must own the source actor to move its items into the Vault.
MK_SHADOWDARK.sundering.title: Sunder an item?
MK_SHADOWDARK.sundering.prompt: {actor} is about to take {damage} damage from a melee attack. Sunder an equipped item to cancel the attack?
MK_SHADOWDARK.sundering.destroyWarning: The selected item will be permanently destroyed. Declining or closing this prompt applies the damage normally.
MK_SHADOWDARK.sundering.chosen: {actor} chose to sunder {item} to cancel the melee attack.
MK_SHADOWDARK.sundering.declined: {actor} chose to take the melee attack's damage.
MK_SHADOWDARK.sundering.promptFailed: The Sundering prompt could not be completed. Damage remains pending; the GM can reload to resume it.
MK_SHADOWDARK.dtp.label: DTP
MK_SHADOWDARK.dtp.gmOnly: Only the GM can edit DTP.
MK_SHADOWDARK.dtp.rules: Each attempt costs 1 DTP, whether it succeeds or fails. Starred (*) activities also cost 10 gp × PC level. Pass the listed check to succeed. Luck tokens cannot be used on these checks.
MK_SHADOWDARK.dtp.outcomes: The GM applies successful rewards, training limits, items, and narrative consequences.
MK_SHADOWDARK.dtp.requirements: I have access to the selected activity's required facility, appropriate equipment and lodging, and meet its prerequisites.
MK_SHADOWDARK.dtp.classRequired: This training requires the listed class hit die or spellcasting ability.
MK_SHADOWDARK.dtp.insufficient: Not enough DTP or gold, or the character's level is unavailable.
MK_SHADOWDARK.dtp.rollUnavailable: Shadowdark's native check dialog is unavailable.
MK_SHADOWDARK.dtp.spent: Spent 1 DTP and {gold} gp. Remaining: {remaining} DTP.
MK_SHADOWDARK.dtp.reportFailed: The downtime costs were paid, but the result could not be posted to chat. Check the console before retrying.
MK_SHADOWDARK.dtp.attemptFailed: The downtime attempt could not be completed.
